message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total number of employees, using headcount data from annual 10-K filings.", "rationale": "Rapid expansion in workforce may signal aggressive growth strategies or overinvestment; lower or negative growth may indicate operational efficiency or retrenchment.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low or negative employee growth rates"}, {"name": "Net Insider Option Grants", "construction": "Total number of stock options granted to insiders minus options exercised by insiders over the past twelve months, scaled by total shares outstanding.", "rationale": "A high net grant may signal management's confidence in undervaluation or, alternatively, potential dilution; low or negative net grants may reflect insider skepticism.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high net insider option grants"}, {"name": "Inter-Industry Sales Exposure", "construction": "Percentage of revenues derived from sales to firms outside the company’s primary SIC industry, as disclosed in segment reporting.", "rationale": "High exposure may indicate diversification benefits or lack of focus; low exposure may reflect industry specialization and competitive advantage.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low inter-industry sales exposure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Accruals Ratio", "construction": "(Change in current assets - change in current liabilities - change in cash + change in short-term debt) divided by average total assets over the past year.", "rationale": "High short-term accruals may reflect earnings management and lower earnings quality, leading to lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low short-term accruals ratios"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Risk", "construction": "Percentage of cost of goods sold paid to the single largest supplier, as disclosed in 10-K footnotes.", "rationale": "Dependence on a single supplier may increase operational risk and reduce bargaining power, impacting long-term profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low supplier concentration risk"}, {"name": "Effective Tax Rate Deviation", "construction": "Absolute difference between the firm’s effective tax rate and the median effective tax rate for its SIC peer group, based on most recent fiscal year.", "rationale": "Large deviations may signal tax avoidance or inefficiency, possibly affecting sustainability of reported earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with low effective tax rate deviation"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Cumulative R&D expense over the past five years divided by the sum of annual depreciation and amortization over the same period.", "rationale": "High ratios may indicate heavy investment in intangible assets not reflected on the balance sheet, potentially underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high R&D capitalization ratios"}, {"name": "Board Tenure Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of years of tenure among board members, using board composition disclosures from proxy statements.", "rationale": "Higher dispersion may signal a mix of experience and fresh perspectives, improving governance and adaptability.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high board tenure dispersion"}, {"name": "Net Working Capital Turnover Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percent change in (annual sales divided by average net working capital), using balance sheet and income statement data.", "rationale": "Increasing turnover may reflect improving operational efficiency and better capital allocation.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high net working capital turnover growth"}, {"name": "Segment Profit Margin Divergence", "construction": "Standard deviation of profit margins across business segments, as reported in annual segment disclosures.", "rationale": "High divergence may reveal hidden growth opportunities or risks in underperforming segments.", "higher_returns_for": "firms with high segment profit margin divergence"}]}
